items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Now this time he did convince me that -- he was a Jewish man, you know, and he told me -- he could tell me about this because the Jewish people had been through the same type of thing that the black people go through

ctx.x: Now they came after me to do that. Okay. Now, here comes Father Klein again. I was gonna take it; there was no question about it. I mean I was definitely gonna take it. Now this time he did convince me that -- he was a

Jewish man, you know, and he told me -- he could tell me about this because the Jewish people had been through the same type of thing that the black people go through, but the things that you want to do -- the normal thing, it's -- it'll be construed that the people who follow you may not get a chance -- well, I was in the middle of the contract; you had to sign contracts, you know; when you were on staff, you signed a yearly contract. And so this was my 2nd year in about the 3rd month.
